svg.text: STAGE 462 · TOPIC 102 · SVG 106 · 🎉 HISTORIC 465-DIMENSION MILESTONE (P917–P918)
Enterprise WebRTC RFC 9143 / RFC 8843 BUNDLE Demux & SSRC Latching Guard
Eliminating Cross-m=-Line Dynamic PT Collisions Feeding Video into Opus & SSRC Latching Table Eviction
🎉 465 EVALUATION DIMENSIONS
927 Guards · 936 Probes · 904 Tests
❌ Unguarded BUNDLE Demux: PT=96 Collision & SSRC Eviction
1. Cross-m=-Line PT=96 Collision Feeding Video Bytes to Opus
• SDP assigns PT=96 in m=audio (RED) AND PT=96 in m=video (VP8).
• Camera switch emits new video SSRC without a=mid header extension.
• RFC 9143 §9.2 fallback matches PT=96 to m=audio → feeds 1,200-byte
compressed video frame straight into the Opus audio decoder!
Result: Deafening Static Burst & Corrupted Opus Decoder State
2. Unbounded SSRC->MID Latching Table Flood & Voice Eviction
• Demuxer latches every new (SSRC -> MID) pair arriving on socket.
• Rogue or buggy peer rotates 50 random SSRCs/sec with MID headers.
• Uncapped table leaks memory, or naive LRU eviction kicks out the
active primary microphone SSRC during brief DTX silence!
Result: Primary Voice SSRC Evicted & Demux Routing Table Exhaustion
✅ RFC 9143 Unique PT/MID Guard (P917) & SSRC Quota Guard (P918)
P917 · RFC 9143 Disjoint Dynamic PT [1, 32] & Mandatory MID Guard
• Enforces 100% disjoint dynamic PTs (96..127) across all m= lines.
• Clamps distinct dynamic PTs per BUNDLE group to [1, 32].
• Isolates unlatched packets missing a=mid header extension in 0ms.
• Zero video-into-audio cross-track static explosions!
clampedCrossMediaLinePtCollisionOrMisroutedPackets = 0 · PTs ∈ [1, 32]
P918 · RFC 9143 SSRC Latching Quota [2, 16] & Voice Pinning Guard
• Pins primary negotiated audio SSRC against LRU eviction.
• Clamps maximum latched (SSRC -> MID) entries per BUNDLE transport
to [2, 16] SSRCs (covering voice + 3-layer Simulcast + RTX).
• 100% defeats SSRC churn floods & bundle-only port-0 blackholes!
clampedEvictedAudioSsrcOrUnboundedLatchEntries = 0 · SSRCs ∈ [2, 16]
